subject: Next steps: sandbox access, evaluation criteria & kickoff windows

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: sandbox access, evaluation criteria & kickoff windows

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Great to hear about Finova's priorities for the payments UX and latency targets for authorization flows. To keep momentum, here's a concise plan I propose for the 3-week sandbox evaluation we discussed:  

1) Success criteria (what we'll measure)
- P99 end-to-end tail latency for typical auth payloads under 50 concurrency: <= 220ms
- Token throughput: sustained 1k reqs/min with <2% error rate
- Semantic quality: false-positive detection rate for fraud-class prompts <= 6% on our seed test set
- Integration: API response schema matches Finova payload v1.2 (see sample in Drive)

2) Ownership & roles
- Finova: Sanjay (POC lead), Emma (technical sponsor / CTO), security reviewer (named in questionnaire)
- Redwood: Monica (overall account lead), Aditya (sales & commercial), Vivek (solutions engineer, integration support), Laura (CSM, success criteria tracking)

3) Access & credentials (what we need from each side)
- Redwood provides: temporary sandbox API key, ephemeral staging endpoint, example client snippets (curl/Node/Python)
- Finova provides: IP allowlist entries for our staging egress, SSO invite email for Emma and the security reviewer, test dataset that mirrors expected payloads (anonymized)

4) Timeline (target)
- Mon 23 Nov: Redwood sends sandbox API key and staging endpoints; Finova returns IP allowlist entries + SSO invite list
- Tue 24 Nov: Integration pairing session (Vivek + Finova engs)
- Wed-Fri 25–27 Nov: Run smoke tests and initial throughput tests
- Week 2: Focused quality evals; adjust batching/quantization settings as needed
- Week 3: Final validation and close with recommendation doc and optional SLA/price discussion

5) Next immediate asks for you today:
- Reply with the SSO invite email addresses (Emma + security reviewer)
- Confirm an IP CIDR or single-IP to allowlist for our staging egress
- Upload the security questionnaire if you want our security team to start reviewing now (we can take preliminary look even before signatures)

Attachments: I can share a starter POC checklist and example requests after you confirm the invite list.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Vivek to coordinate the pairing session once you confirm availability.

Best,
Monica
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
---
